item.title: Multi-Business Booking SaaS Development
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m creating a cloud-based scheduling and booking platform that several independent businesses can share under one roof. Each business must be able to set up its own services—ranging from one-to-one appointments to group classes and even rentable rooms or equipment—and present real-time availability to customers.
Customers should have three payment options at checkout: pay the full amount, leave a deposit, or reserve now and settle at the appointment. Transactions need to flow seamlessly through a gateway such as Stripe or a comparable provider, with automatic receipts and refund handling.
The calendar layer is equally critical: events must appear instantly inside the app and stay in sync with external calendars (Google, Outlook, iCal) to avoid double-booking. Drag-and-drop rescheduling, staff assignment, capacity limits, and automated email/SMS reminders all belong in the core experience.
Because this is true software-as-a-service, I need a multi-tenant architecture where data is isolated yet the codebase remains single. Each tenant gets a branded portal, its own admin dashboard, and role-based permissions for owners, managers, staff, and customers.
Deliverables • Full-stack source code in a Git repo with clear setup instructions • Deployed MVP on my cloud account (AWS preferred, but flexible) • REST or GraphQL API documentation • Basic analytics and audit logs • Test suite plus a brief hand-off walkthrough
If you’ve built something similar—especially with React, Vue, Node.js, Django, or comparable stacks—tell me which technologies you’d use here and share any live examples. I’m ready to move quickly once the right approach is confirmed.

item.title: WordPress & E-Commerce Developer/Manager Needed for B2B Online Store Platform

Key Responsibilities 1. WordPress Website Management Manage and maintain our existing WordPress website. Improve functionality, navigation, product presentation, and user experience. Manage plugins, themes, integrations, product content, and landing pages. Improve website performance, SEO, lead generation, and conversion opportunities. 2. Website Development Assist with the development and ongoing improvement of our next-generation website and digital platform. Translate business requirements into practical website functionality. Strong WordPress experience, including administration, plugins, themes, security, performance, and integrations. Experience building and managing e-commerce websites. Experience with WooCommerce, Shopify, or similar e-commerce platforms. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and ideally PHP. Experience working with APIs, webhooks, databases, and CRM integrations. Experience managing large product catalogues and online storefronts. More than anything, we're looking for someone who can take ownership.
We are not simply looking for someone to update pages or maintain WordPress plugins.
We want someone who:
Understands the business opportunity behind e-commerce. Can recommend better approaches instead of simply following instructions. Has enough technical knowledge to work directly with developers. Can take a project from concept through implementation. Can identify opportunities for automation and scalability. Understands that the ultimate objective is to create a better customer experience while generating additional revenue. When Applying
Please include:
Examples of WordPress websites you have built or managed. Examples of e-commerce websites or customer-specific online stores you have developed. Your experience with WooCommerce, Shopify, or similar platforms. Your experience working with APIs, webhooks, CRM systems, or custom integrations. Your knowledge of PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Examples of B2B e-commerce projects, if applicable. How you would approach building a scalable system for launching multiple customer-specific online stores. Your availability and preferred working arrangement. Your hourly or project rate.
Important: We are looking for an ongoing development relationship, not simply a one-time website build. There is significant opportunity for continued work if the initial projects are successful.

item.title: WordPress Malware Recovery & SEO Cleanup
item.description:
250-750 EUR | # WordPress Security & SEO Recovery Specialist
**Malware Removal | Google Index Recovery | Long-Term Technical Partnership**
We are looking for an experienced WordPress security specialist to recover a compromised business website and potentially become our long-term technical operations partner.
### The current challenge
Our WordPress website was recently compromised.
Google Search Console now reports hundreds of thousands of suspicious URLs, despite the website containing only a small number of legitimate pages.
Unauthorized product snippets and potentially malicious structured data have also appeared.
We are not looking for someone who simply installs a security plugin or temporarily removes the visible symptoms.
We need a specialist who understands the underlying problem and can build a reliable long-term solution.
### Scope of work
**Phase 1 – Investigation & Recovery** - Investigate the WordPress installation, plugins, themes, database and hosting environment. - Identify the likely entry point and investigate persistence mechanisms. - Remove malicious code, unauthorized content and backdoors. - Restore the website securely without compromising legitimate content. - Provide a short technical report covering findings, corrective actions and remaining risks.
**Phase 2 – Google Index Recovery** - Analyze compromised URLs and unauthorized product structured data. - Develop a scalable strategy to remove malicious URLs from Google's index. - Verify correct HTTP responses and clean sitemaps. - Preserve legitimate pages and organic search visibility. - Establish a process for monitoring indexing recovery.
**Phase 3 – Long-Term Security & Monitoring** - Implement automated malware and file-integrity monitoring. - Establish WordPress security updates, backups and recovery procedures. - Configure security alerts and independent uptime monitoring. - Provide regular maintenance reports and defined incident-response procedures.
### Required experience
- WordPress malware removal and incident investigation - PHP, MySQL and WordPress internals - WordPress security hardening and server administration - Google Search Console and technical SEO recovery - Automated monitoring and backup management
Experience with large-scale SEO spam infections involving thousands of malicious URLs is particularly valuable.
### Application – Technical Screening
Please answer the following questions:
1. How would you identify and eliminate the root cause of this WordPress compromise, rather than simply removing visible malware?
2. Why would you handle 100,000+ spam URLs already discovered or indexed by Google using your preferred strategy compared to alternative approaches?
3. What monitoring setup would you implement to detect future compromises automatically, including malware, unauthorized URLs and suspicious file changes?
4. Would you recommend repairing the existing WordPress installation or rebuilding it from verified clean components? Explain what would influence your decision.
Please also include one relevant past project, your hourly rate and your preferred structure for a long-term maintenance agreement.
After reviewing your complete application, including the attached questionnaire, we'll be happy to get to know you via video call and get proceed as soon as possible.
### What we offer
We propose starting with a paid technical assessment, followed by a clearly scoped recovery project.
For the right candidate, we offer:
- A recurring maintenance agreement with predictable compensation - Performance incentives linked to measurable security and maintenance quality - Technical ownership and autonomy within an agreed scope - Preferred access to future development and automation projects - The opportunity to grow into a long-term technical partnership
We value proactive problem-solving, transparency, reliability and a genuine interest in building sustainable systems.
**Our goal is to establish a long-term technical partnership, not just complete a one-time malware cleanup.**

item.title: Car Giveaway E-commerce Platform
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m building a Canada-focused online store that sells a single, limited-edition hoodie and automatically enters every buyer into a car giveaway. I need a full, production-ready website that:
• Handles hoodie sales securely, accepts all major cards and Apple/Google Pay, and lets me adjust pricing or inventory without touching code. • Allocates giveaway entries proportionally—one hoodie equals one entry, two hoodies equals two entries, and so on—then writes that total to the customer’s account. • Shows each logged-in customer exactly how many entries they hold; no other account data needs to surface for this phase. • Displays a live countdown visible to everyone until the campaign ends, after which a verifiable, online random draw selects the winner. • Publishes the winner’s first name/last initial, a brief story, and an image on a public “Past Winners” page while archiving completed giveaways for transparency. • Lets me trigger or schedule the draw, view all entries in the back-end, export them to CSV, and mark a winner with one click. • Is responsive, fast, SEO-friendly, and ready to scale for high traffic spikes near giveaway close.

1. Your proposed tech stack and why it fits. 2. How you’ll implement the random draw so that customers can trust its fairness. 3. A timeline broken into key milestones (storefront, entry logic, draw module, launch).
I’ll provide branding assets and hoodie specs. Code ownership transfers to me on project completion. If you’ve built contest or raffle sites before, send a link; it will help speed up selection.

Quick and accurate communication throughout the entire booking process is also essential. Additionally, this will be an ongoing project involving updates such as new open house dates and sales events. When you respond, focus on the relevant experience that proves you’ve done this before. Links or screenshots of similar HighLevel builds for venues or events work best. I will share current snapshots, access credentials, and priorities once we agree on the approach, and I expect clear communication while milestones move forward.
